State management logic is separated into Zustand stores (useSearchStore, useThemeStore) instead of being mixed in components. Theme toggle logic is in the store, not in UI components.
Business logic for URL validation and icon selection is extracted to utility functions (isSafeUrl, getFallbackIcon) separate from presentation components.
evidence.snippet:
export const isSafeUrl = (url: string | undefined): boolean =>
  !!url && url.startsWith('https://') && !url.includes('javascript:')

export const getFallbackIcon = (category: string) =>
  categoryIcons[category?.toLowerCase()] ?? <CircleQuestionMark />

checkboxes.description: File structure logical and intuitive (components, pages, utils, etc.)

evidence.reasoning: File structure follows clear separation of concerns: components/, pages/, hooks/, lib/, stores/, types/, routes/. Each directory has a specific purpose and is logically organized.
evidence.snippet:
src/
  components/  - Reusable UI components
  pages/       - Page-level components
  hooks/       - Custom React hooks
  lib/         - Utilities and services (api, mutations, styles)
  stores/      - State management (Zustand)
  types/       - TypeScript type definitions
  routes/      - TanStack Router route definitions

evidence.reasoning: Components are organized with co-located files: each component has its index.tsx and skeleton.tsx in the same directory (e.g., ToolCard/index.tsx, ToolCard/skeleton.tsx). This makes related files easy to find.

src/components/ToolsTable/skeleton.tsx

rules.reasoning: The codebase demonstrates strong professional practices in API centralization, business logic separation, and file organization. All API calls are properly centralized in lib/api.ts and wrapped in custom hooks, business logic is separated through hooks and Zustand stores, and the file structure follows clear separation of concerns. Constants are well-extracted (BASE_URL, gradients, statusStyles, CATEGORIES, DEPARTMENTS) and styling is organized with dedicated CSS files and style utilities. However, there is significant code duplication that prevents a perfect score: pagination controls are duplicated across DashboardPage and ToolsPage, action dropdown menus are duplicated in ToolCard and ToolsTable, and currency formatting logic is repeated multiple times. These duplications should be extracted into reusable components and utility functions. Overall score: 17/20 points (85%), with the main deduction for code duplication issues.
